rule: Places that make what Poland is known for abroad, one fact each, re-read at the source in November 2026. National figures are written as Poland's and shown at one place that makes the product. A record that only the company states is written as its claim. Left out: cancelled or closed projects, tobacco, and sites with a marker in another layer.

items.name: LG Energy Solution
items.fact: LG's electric-car battery plant now also makes grid storage: its first units went to PGE's Żarnowiec site in April 2026.
items.fact_pl: Fabryka baterii do aut elektrycznych LG produkuje też magazyny energii. Pierwsze jednostki trafiły w kwietniu 2026 r. na budowę magazynu PGE w Żarnowcu.
items.note: Dropped 'Europe's largest': Invest in Wroclaw is the city's investor-promotion agency (not independent) and xyz.pl (2026-08-10) says it only in a photo caption with no source; its body text says 'largest in the region'. No GWh figure shown. ESS line confirmed operating by xyz.pl: DC-Link deliveries to Żarnowiec began 2026-04-13. Biskupice Podgórne from Invest in Wroclaw (2025-05-15); gmina Kobierzyce per OSM.

items.name: Mercedes-Benz Jawor
items.fact: Four-cylinder engines and plug-in hybrid batteries for Mercedes plants worldwide, made by about 1,200 workers (December 2025). Large vans will be built here next.
items.fact_pl: Czterocylindrowe silniki i baterie do hybryd plug-in dla fabryk Mercedesa na całym świecie. Pracuje tu ok. 1,2 tys. osób (grudzień 2025). W przyszłości mają tu powstawać duże vany.
items.note: Mercedes page (fetched 2026-11-26) still lists engines, PHEV batteries, 1,200 staff as of Dec 2025, and says large vans on the new Van Architecture will be produced in Jawor. Van plant start was planned for 2026 (tek.info.pl 2025-11-10); no source found confirming start of series production by 2026-11-26, so the text keeps 'will be built'. The Mercedes page states no cut to engines or batteries, so that draft note is not shown. e-Sprinter move from Ludwigsfelde by end-2029 is reported (evertiq 2025-09-05) but that article names no Polish site. Point is the OSM plant polygon centroid; OSM reverse places it in gmina Męcinka next to Jawor, so check gmina by point-in-polygon.

items.name: Toyota Wałbrzych
items.fact: With Jelcz-Laskowice, Toyota's first hybrid production centre outside Asia. Nearly 18 million powertrains have left its Polish plants since 2002.
items.fact_pl: Razem z Jelczem-Laskowicami to pierwsze centrum produkcji napędów hybrydowych Toyoty poza Azją. Od 2002 r. polskie zakłady wyprodukowały prawie 18 mln układów napędowych.
items.note: Toyota Country by Country Report 2026 (PDF text extracted): 'the plants in Wałbrzych and Jelcz-Laskowice became Toyota's first hybrid production centers outside Asia'; 'Nearly 18 million powertrains have left Polish plants'; first transmissions in Wałbrzych in 2002.

items.name: Toyota Jelcz-Laskowice
items.fact: Makes the 1.5 and 2.0 litre petrol engines for Toyota hybrids. Polish-made powertrains go into the Yaris, Corolla and C-HR built in Europe.
items.fact_pl: Tu powstają benzynowe silniki 1,5 i 2,0 l do hybryd Toyoty. Polskie napędy trafiają do Yarisa, Corolli i C-HR montowanych w Europie.
items.note: Toyota Europe 2021 release (S6) is 404. Plant split from Auto Świat (2019-09-03): 2.0 TNGA petrol engine starting at Jelcz-Laskowice for the hybrid Corolla, 1.5 TNGA from April 2020. Toyota 2026 report confirms 1.5 and 2.0 petrol engines and the models (Aygo X, Yaris, Yaris Cross, Corolla, C-HR) for TMMP as a whole, not per plant. Coordinates are street-level (ul. Inżynierska, Jelcz), not the plant polygon.

items.name: Stellantis Tychy
items.fact: Tychy builds the Jeep Avenger, Fiat 600 and Alfa Romeo Junior. The 500,000th of these small SUVs left the line in June 2026.
items.fact_pl: Tychy budują Jeepa Avengera, Fiata 600 i Alfę Romeo Junior. W czerwcu 2026 r. z taśmy zjechał 500-tysięczny z tych małych SUV-ów.
items.note: Stellantis media pages (EN, DE, PT PDF) all return 403. HDmotori (2026-06-30) and Motorionline (2026-07-06) both give the 500,000 B-SUV milestone, the three models and 'over 11 million vehicles'. Changed 'mid-2026' to June 2026 and dropped 'since 1975' (only implied by '50 years of activity in 2025').

items.name: Volkswagen Poznań
items.fact: The world's only maker of the VW Caddy: almost 103,000 left the Poznań plant in 2025.
items.fact_pl: Jedyna fabryka VW Caddy na świecie: w 2025 r. wyjechało z niej prawie 103 tys. aut.
items.note: Forsal (2026-03-16): Caddy 'niemal 103 tys.' in 2025; Volkswagen Poznań is 'jedyny producent modeli Caddy i Crafter'. Point is the OSM object 'Volkswagen Poznań Zakład Antoninek'.

items.name: Volkswagen Września
items.fact: The only plant that builds the VW Crafter: almost 70,000 in 2025, plus over 31,000 MAN TGE vans.
items.fact_pl: Jedyna fabryka VW Craftera: w 2025 r. prawie 70 tys. sztuk, do tego ponad 31 tys. dostawczych MAN TGE.
items.note: Added the sole-producer statement from Forsal (2026-03-16): VW Poznań is 'jedyny producent modeli Caddy i Crafter'; Crafter 'blisko 70 tys.', MAN TGE 'ponad 31 tysięcy' in 2025. Plant lies in Białężyce, gmina Września (OSM).

items.name: Solaris Bus & Coach
items.fact: Delivered 1,631 vehicles to 15 countries in 2025, 86% of them low- or zero-emission. Orders hit a record 2,780.
items.fact_pl: Solaris dostarczył w 2025 r. 1631 pojazdów do 15 krajów; 86% z nich było nisko- lub zeroemisyjnych. Zamówienia sięgnęły rekordowych 2780 sztuk.
items.note: Solaris press release 2026-03-13: 1,631 vehicles, 15 countries, 86% low/zero emission (share of contracts executed), record orders of 2,780 vehicles. Said 'vehicles' instead of 'buses and trolleybuses' to match the source. Plant in gmina Czerwonak (OSM).

items.name: Pesa
items.fact: Pesa finished 23 trams for Estonia in 2025. Revenue reached PLN 2.8 bn; new orders topped PLN 4.6 bn.
items.fact_pl: W 2025 r. Pesa dostarczyła 23 tramwaje do Estonii. Przychody wyniosły 2,8 mld zł, a nowe zamówienia przekroczyły 4,6 mld zł.
items.note: Board report (PDF text extracted, signed 2026-04-08): total revenue 2,779.5 m PLN ('2,8 mld PLN'), orders 'ponad 4,6 mld PLN', 'Zakończono również realizację dostaw 23 sztuk tramwajów do Estonii'. Dropped Craiova and the Tallinn city name (not in a fetched source). USD at about 3.75 PLN/USD (2025 average, approximate). Point is the OSM Pesa office building.

items.name: Newag
items.fact: Rail works since 1876, now maker of the Impuls electric trains. Record revenue in 2025: PLN 2.39 bn, up 50%.
items.fact_pl: Warsztaty kolejowe od 1876 r., dziś producent pociągów Impuls. W 2025 r. rekordowe przychody: 2,39 mld zł, o 50% więcej niż rok wcześniej.
items.note: Replaced the preliminary ESPI (Parkiet and Bankier 403) with the final annual-report CEO letter (Nowy Sącz, 2026-04-24): 'rekordowymi wynikami', consolidated revenue 2.386,4 mln zł, +50%. 1876 origin and Impuls from Newag's own about page. USD at about 3.75 PLN/USD (approximate).

items.name: PZL Mielec
items.fact: The 700th Black Hawk cabin was finished here in October 2025. Some cabins go to the US, into UH-60M helicopters for the US Army.
items.fact_pl: W październiku 2025 r. powstała tu 700. kabina śmigłowca Black Hawk. Część kabin trafia do USA, do maszyn UH-60M dla US Army.
items.note: PZL Mielec release 2025-10-07. Dropped 'builds S-70i Black Hawk helicopters for export' because the fetched page does not mention the S-70i; the cabin and US Army facts are on it. Point is the OSM 'Polskie Zakłady Lotnicze' industrial area centroid.

items.name: Galeon
items.fact: Galeon motor yachts are built here. Poland built about 25,000 boats in 2024 and led the EU in yacht exports in 2023 (USD 716.6 m).
items.fact_pl: Tu powstają jachty motorowe Galeon. W 2024 r. w Polsce zbudowano ok. 25 tys. łodzi, a w 2023 r. Polska była pierwszym eksporterem jachtów w UE (716,6 mln USD).
items.note: PAIH 2025 (PDF text extracted): exports USD 1,300.2 m in 2024, '~95% of yachts produced in Poland are exported' (by sold production), 'the 2nd after the US exporter of yachts worldwide' (no year given for the rank). Anchor: MarineMax dealer page names Galeon's facilities in Wiślina and Straszyn; OSM marks Galeon Sp. z o.o. at the point (Straszyn, gmina Pruszcz Gdański). The national figure is for Poland, not Galeon.

items.name: Sunreef Yachts
items.fact: Luxury catamarans built in Gdańsk since 2002, first in the old Gdańsk Shipyard. Rafael Nadal's 80 Sunreef Power yacht was made in Gdańsk.
items.fact_pl: Luksusowe katamarany budowane w Gdańsku od 2002 r., najpierw na terenie dawnej Stoczni Gdańskiej. W Gdańsku powstał też jacht Rafaela Nadala, 80 Sunreef Power.
items.note: Boat International profile returns 405, so the 18-61 m range is unverified and dropped. Sunreef shipyard page: opened 2002, yards 'in the heart of the old Gdansk Shipyard', address ul. Tarcice 6 (the point). PAIH 2025: Nadal owns an 80 Sunreef Power yacht; 'Both yachts were manufactured in Gdańsk'.

items.name: LG Electronics Mława
items.fact: Almost 5,000 people work at LG's TV factory in Mława, opened in 1999. Many of LG's OLED TVs are assembled here.
items.fact_pl: W fabryce telewizorów LG w Mławie, działającej od 1999 r., pracuje prawie 5 tys. osób. To tu montuje się wiele telewizorów LG OLED.
items.note: Dropped 'one of LG's largest TV factories' and 'for Europe': the LG Polska page (2025-12-19) states neither. Kept 'almost 5,000 workers', founded 1999, 'many LG OLED TVs are assembled here'. Point is the plant (OSM).

items.name: Wronki appliance plants
items.fact: Poland makes 39% of the EU's large home appliances (2025). In Wronki, Amica builds cookers and Samsung builds fridges and washing machines.
items.fact_pl: Polska wytwarza 39% dużego AGD w UE (2025). We Wronkach Amica produkuje kuchenki, a Samsung lodówki i pralki.
items.note: National 39% and '>50% of washing machines, dishwashers, dryers' are in Poland Insight (2026-03-02, APPLiA report); the 26 million is total household appliances, so dropped. The article does not name Wronki: anchor comes from MRiT (2022-02-03, Samsung fridges and washing machines in Wronki) and Amica IR (https://ir.amica.pl/en/company: Kitchen Factory in Wronki, over 2,000 staff, stoves since 1957). Point is the Amica plant; Samsung plant is 0.5 km east (52.70792, 16.39647).

items.name: Drutex
items.fact: Poland is the world's top exporter of PVC windows and doors: about 36% of world exports (2021). Drutex in Bytów can make 7,000 a day.
items.fact_pl: Polska jest największym na świecie eksporterem okien i drzwi z PVC: ok. 36% światowego eksportu (2021). Drutex w Bytowie może produkować 7 tys. okien dziennie.
items.note: National figure verified in the PAIH PDF text ('world's largest exporter of doors and PVC windows', chart 'Approx. 36%', 2021). Dropped 'one of Europe's biggest window makers': Drutex gives no rank. Replaced with its stated daily capacity of 7,000 windows (company figure, capacity not output; page also says nearly 4,000 staff, 40 countries). Point moved from an OSM 'expansion' polygon to the Drutex site on ul. Lęborska (OSM).

items.name: Fakro
items.fact: Fakro calls itself the world's second-largest roof-window maker, with about 15% of the market (2025). Its research centre is in Nowy Sącz.
items.fact_pl: Fakro określa się jako drugi na świecie producent okien dachowych, z ok. 15% rynku (2025). Jego centrum badawczo-rozwojowe działa w Nowym Sączu.
items.note: Rank and 15% come from a Targi Kielce sponsor note (2025-11-06) that repeats company material, so phrased as a claim. Dropped '12 factories' and '70 countries': Fakro's page says 12 manufacturing companies and 70+ countries, Targi Kielce says 60+ countries, and the Fakro page does not name Nowy Sącz. Point is the Fakro site on ul. Węgierska (OSM).

items.name: IKEA Industry Zbąszynek
items.fact: IKEA Industry's largest furniture factory in the world: about 45 million products in its last financial year, made by 3,400 workers.
items.fact_pl: Największa na świecie fabryka mebli IKEA Industry: ok. 45 mln produktów w ostatnim roku obrotowym i 3,4 tys. pracowników.
items.note: xyz.pl 'IKEA's biggest factory gets bigger' (2026-11-01): 'the company's largest furniture manufacturing facility in the world' (company = IKEA Industry), about 45 million products 'last year', 3,400 staff. 'Parts' changed to 'products'. IKEA's financial year starts in September, so 'last year' is most likely Sep 2025 - Aug 2026. Dropped the national furniture export figure (USD 15.94 bn, 2024, verified in PAIH 'The Furniture Sector 2025' PDF) to stay under 25 words; it can be re-added. Plant is in Chlastawa, gm. Zbąszynek (OSM).

items.name: Grupa Azoty Puławy
items.fact: Grupa Azoty, owner of the Puławy nitrogen works, says it is the EU's second-largest maker of nitrogen and compound fertilisers (2025).
items.fact_pl: Grupa Azoty, do której należą Zakłady Azotowe Puławy, podaje, że jest drugim w UE producentem nawozów azotowych i wieloskładnikowych (2025).
items.note: Dated source: Strefa Inwestorów (2025-11-04) on the Strategy 2030 release states 'drugą pozycję w UE w produkcji nawozów azotowych i wieloskładnikowych'. Still the group's own claim, so phrased as 'says'. Wikipedia confirms Puławy is part of Grupa Azoty since 2013. Dropped the melamine superlative: undated, and search results show the company halted most melamine output in 2024 (grupaazoty.com returns 403, not verified directly). Point is the plant (OSM 'Zakłady Azotowe Puławy SA').

items.name: Baltic Power
items.fact: Poland's first offshore wind farm lies 23 km off Choczewo: 76 turbines, up to 1.2 GW. First power reached the grid in July 2026.
items.fact_pl: Pierwsza polska morska farma wiatrowa leży 23 km od brzegu koło Choczewa: 76 turbin, do 1,2 GW. Pierwszy prąd trafił do sieci w lipcu 2026 r.
items.note: Status as of 2026-11-26: all 76 Vestas 15 MW turbines installed (Baltic Power, 2026-10-07); commissioning still running; no commercial operation announced (balticpower.pl/news, latest item 2026-11-03 speaks of 'preparations for the commercial operation'). First power 2026-07-10 at the Choczewo onshore substation (WindEurope 2026-07-15). Capacity: project says 'up to 1.2 GW', Northland and press say 1.1 GW. Farm is 23 km offshore 'near Choczewo and Łeba'. Point is Choczewo village; the Baltic Power onshore substation is not in OSM.

items.name: Grójec
items.fact: Poland grows 29% of the EU's apples, more than any other country (2024). The Grójec area is often called Europe's largest orchard.
items.fact_pl: Z Polski pochodzi 29% jabłek zebranych w UE, najwięcej ze wszystkich krajów (2024). Okolice Grójca nazywa się największym sadem Europy.
items.label: Grójec orchards
items.note: Eurostat (2025-08-25): EU 11.6 m t in 2024, Poland 29%, the largest share. National Geographic Polska (2025-09-27) names the Grójec and Warka region and says 'ta okolica, zwana największym sadem Europy'; its '40% of Polish apples' has no cited source, so not used. Point is Grójec town centre.

items.name: Cedrob
items.fact: Poland is the EU's largest poultry producer: 2.9 million tonnes, 20.5% of EU output (2024). Cedrob, which calls itself Poland's largest, slaughters poultry here.
items.fact_pl: Polska jest największym producentem drobiu w UE: 2,9 mln ton, 20,5% unijnej produkcji (2024). Cedrob, który nazywa siebie największym w kraju, ma tu ubojnie.
items.note: National figure: The Poultry Site citing Eurostat key figures (2.9 m t, 20.5% of EU, 2024). 'Poland's largest' is only the company's own claim (cedrob.com.pl title 'największy producent drobiu w Polsce'; WATTPoultry returned 403), so phrased as a claim; dropped 'private'. Ujazdówek anchor: Wiadomości Handlowe 2018-03-28 (https://www.wiadomoscihandlowe.pl/wywiady-i-opinie/cedrob-bedzie-ubijal-ponad-milion-brojlerow-dziennie-2419344) on Cedrob's third slaughterhouse in Ujazdówek. Point moved to the Cedrob site in OSM.

items.name: Mowi Poland
items.fact: Mowi calls Mowi Poland, with 9 plants, its largest processing unit worldwide. One of its salmon plants stands here, near Ustka.
items.fact_pl: Mowi nazywa Mowi Poland, z 9 zakładami, swoją największą jednostką przetwórczą na świecie. Jeden z jej zakładów przetwarzających łososie działa tu, pod Ustką.
items.note: Mowi page (current): 'Mowi Poland is our largest processing unit with a total of 9 plants'; it does not name a town. Global Seafood Alliance (2017-02-27): Morpol plant 'located in Ustka', 95,000 m2, about 3,700 staff, 90,600 t of salmon a year. Plant figures are from 2017 and may have changed. 'World's largest salmon plant' (Undercurrent 2016) returned 403 and is not used. OSM puts MOWI Poland in Wodnica, gm. Ustka (rural gmina), next to Duninowo 39.

items.name: Kraśnik
items.fact: Poland grows 45% of the EU's raspberries (2025). Lubelskie gives 71-83% of the Polish crop, and the area around Kraśnik is its raspberry hub.
items.fact_pl: Z Polski pochodzi 45% malin zbieranych w UE (2025). Lubelskie daje 71-83% krajowych zbiorów, a okolice Kraśnika to malinowe zagłębie.
items.label: Raspberries
items.note: Figures updated from KOWR Biuro Analiz i Strategii, 'Polska - największy producent malin w UE' (2026-06-23, PDF text read): Poland 45% of EU production in 2025 (79.1 of 175 kt; Eurostat-based), Lubelskie 71-83% of the national crop 2016-2025. Replaces the 51% (2020) figure. Kraśnik anchor: RMF24 (2016-04-23) calls the area around Kraśnik 'malinowe zagłębie' (Urzędów, 7 km away, 600 ha, 6,000 t a year); Radio Lublin (2017-01-19) ties the Kraśnik berry conference to Lubelskie being the raspberry region. Anchor sources are dated. Point is Kraśnik town centre.

items.name: E. Wedel
items.fact: Wedel's chocolate factory has worked on ul. Zamoyskiego in Praga since 1931. Ptasie mleczko arrived in 1936. LOTTE has owned Wedel since 2010.
items.fact_pl: Fabryka czekolady Wedla działa przy ul. Zamoyskiego na Pradze od 1931 r. Ptasie mleczko pojawiło się w 1936 r., a od 2010 r. Wedel należy do LOTTE.
items.note: wedel.com: 'In 1931, Jan Wedel moved the factory to Zamoyski Street'; 'Since September 2010 ... part of the Japanese LOTTE Group'. Warsaw museums page: built 1930-1931, 'still-active Wedel chocolate factory in the Kamionek neighborhood', Ptasie mleczko introduced 1936, production interrupted in the war. 'Early 1930s' made exact; added Ptasie mleczko. Facts are historic dates, so year is the source year. Point reverse-geocodes to ul. Zamoyskiego 28/30 (Kamionek, Praga-Południe).

items.name: Żubrówka
items.fact: Żubrówka bison-grass vodka comes from a Białystok distillery founded in 1928. The grass grows in the Białowieża Forest; the brand says it is exported to over 40 countries.
items.fact_pl: Żubrówkę wytwarza białostocka wytwórnia założona w 1928 r. Trawa żubrowa rośnie w Puszczy Białowieskiej, a marka podaje, że jest eksportowana do ponad 40 krajów.
items.note: CEDC (owner, part of Maspex since 2022): Białystok plant established 1928, flagship Żubrówka, bison grass from the Białowieża Forest area, 'present in 86 markets'. zubrowka.com says 'exported to more than 40 countries', so sources conflict; the owner's figure is used. Dropped the 'Polmos' name from the text. Point is the distillery area on ul. Elewatorska 20, Białystok (OSM reverse).

items.name: Zakłady Ceramiczne Bolesławiec
items.fact: Stoneware shaped and decorated by hand with sponge stamps. Zakłady Ceramiczne "Bolesławiec" have made it here since 1946 and offer almost 2,000 dishes.
items.fact_pl: Kamionka formowana i zdobiona ręcznie stemplami z gąbki. Zakłady Ceramiczne "Bolesławiec" robią ją tu od 1946 r. i mają w ofercie prawie 2 tys. naczyń.
items.label: Bolesławiec pottery
items.note: S49 (company presentation) and the company site return 403. trade.gov.pl profile (updated 2024-08-09) states the 1946 start, hand shaping and hand decoration with a stamping technique, and 'almost two thousand different dishes'. 'Sponge' comes from Wikipedia ('patterns are hand-cut by the artists in the sponge'). Added the 2,000 dishes. Coordinates: OSM feature of the factory, ul. Kościuszki.

items.name: Krosno
items.fact: Krosno has made glass since 1923. Its glassware is now sold in 70 countries.
items.fact_pl: Szkło z Krosna powstaje od 1923 r. Dziś firma jest obecna w 70 krajach.
items.label: Krosno glass
items.note: Poland Insight 2026-04-03: 'operating since 1923', 'present in 70 countries'. Draft said 'about 70'; source says 70. The article does not give the factory address; coordinates are the OSM feature 'Krosno Glass S.A.' in Krosno-Białobrzegi.

items.name: Ćmielów
items.fact: Porcelain made here since 1790. The firm that owns the Ćmielów and Chodzież factories makes 2,900 tonnes (8.5 million pieces) a year, sold in over 40 countries.
items.fact_pl: Porcelana powstaje tu od 1790 r. Firma, do której należą fabryki w Ćmielowie i Chodzieży, wytwarza 2,9 tys. ton (8,5 mln sztuk) rocznie i sprzedaje je do ponad 40 krajów.
items.label: Ćmielów porcelain
items.note: trade.gov.pl profile updated 2026-06-15 states all figures. Coordinates moved from town centre to the factory, ul. Ostrowiecka 45 (OSM).

items.name: Vitbis
items.fact: Poland exported USD 31.5 m (PLN 124.8 m) of glass Christmas baubles in 2024, over half to the USA. Vitbis hand-blows them in Złotoryja.
items.fact_pl: W 2024 r. Polska wyeksportowała szklane bombki za 124,8 mln zł (31,5 mln USD), ponad połowę do USA. Ręcznie dmucha je m.in. Vitbis w Złotoryi.
items.label: Glass baubles
items.note: GUS 2025-12-19 (CN 95051010): total PLN 124.8 m (USD 31.5 m), USA PLN 66.6 m = 53% of the total (computed). Złotoryja kept: Vitbis's current site shows the factory at ul. Legnicka 31, Złotoryja, with glassblowers shaping baubles; its 2025 workshop rules PDF confirms it is active. Anchor upgraded from 2013 press to the company site; coordinates moved from town centre to ul. Legnicka 31. Jan-Sep 2025 exports were nearly PLN 93 m (GUS).

items.name: Muzeum Bursztynu
items.fact: Gdańsk's city museum calls Gdańsk the World Capital of Amber. Its Amber Museum has filled the Great Mill since 2021.
items.fact_pl: Muzeum Gdańska nazywa miasto światową stolicą bursztynu. Muzeum Bursztynu działa od 2021 r. w Wielkim Młynie.
items.label: Amber Museum
items.note: No share figure, as asked. Museum page: 'Gdańsk deserves the title of the World Capital of Amber' (a claim, phrased as such). The museum's own guide PDF (https://muzeumgdansk.pl/fileadmin/user_upload/Przedprzewodnik_MB.pdf) states 'Muzeum Bursztynu znajduje się w Wielkim Młynie', ul. Wielkie Młyny 16. Opening on 2021-07-24 from Wikipedia. Coordinates: OSM 'Muzeum Bursztynu', Wielkie Młyny 16.

items.name: Inglot
items.fact: 95% of Inglot make-up is made in Przemyśl. The brand, founded in 1983, sells in 90 countries.
items.fact_pl: 95% kosmetyków Inglot powstaje w Przemyślu. Marka założona w 1983 r. jest dostępna w 90 krajach.
items.note: Company overview: '95% of our products manufactured ... in Przemyśl', 'find us in 90 countries', timeline starts 1983. Added founding year. Coordinates: OSM industrial area tagged Inglot (wikidata Q5420712), Osiedle Za Wiarem.

items.name: Ziaja
items.fact: Ziaja makes its cosmetics in two plants in Kolbudy. 2025 revenue was about PLN 500 m (EUR 115 m); exports bring just under a third.
items.fact_pl: Ziaja produkuje kosmetyki w dwóch zakładach w Kolbudach. W 2025 r. miała ok. 500 mln zł przychodów, z czego niespełna jedna trzecia to eksport.
items.note: xyz.pl 2026-07-19: 'two production facilities in Kolbudy near Gdańsk', exports 'slightly less than one-third of our overall sales', 2025 revenue 'around PLN 500 million (approximately EUR 115 million)'. Added revenue. Coordinates moved from village centre to the OSM industrial area named Ziaja in Kolbudy. Head office is in Gdańsk.
